source: docs/VENDOR_REFERENCE.md section 2 (LSEG Data Library for Python, lseg-data 2.1.1). Statuses are copied from table 2.3; entries not in that table say where they come from in 'notes'.

status_meaning.confirmed: Seen in vendor-authored code or docs in the form shown. May be compiled; still needs a field_validation_log entry (gate G5) before it is used as a production filter predicate.
status_meaning.corrected: Verified only in the form shown here. Use exactly this form; parts noted VERIFY stay configurable.
status_meaning.unverifiable: Could not be confirmed. Configurable only, never hard-coded; preflighted on test_ric before every run; a failure suspends the leg (NOT EVALUATED); never pushed as a SCREEN threshold.

admission.notes: Gate G5 (VENDOR_REFERENCE section 5): a feature is pushed as a SCREEN threshold only after it is admitted, i.e. it has a field_validation_log entry (item, params, test ticker, as_of, value, units, sign, reviewer, date). This default map admits nothing. Admit a feature with "admitted": true on features.<name> in an AITRADING_FIELDMAP_LSEG override, or pass LSEGProvider(admitted=[...]) from the run's admission log. Non-admitted features stay residual (evaluated locally). The universe listing predicates under 'screen' define the universe and are not feature thresholds.

symbology.notes: A ticker passed directly is used as a RIC only if it is an index RIC ('.SPX') or ends with one of these exchange suffixes (an optional '^' delisting tail is ignored); anything else ('BRK.B', 'BRK-B') must come from a SCREEN result or the rics= table, otherwise it is dropped and flagged as unresolved (ADR graft 6). Extend the list in an override for non-US listings.

sessions.notes: VENDOR_REFERENCE 2.1: 'platform.ldp' is the unattended/server session (LSEG Platform content, licence class L3 until gate G3). 'desktop.workspace' (the library default) is licensed for individual use (licence class L4: nothing leaves the workstation) and must not run on a server (ADR section 7), so the adapter opens it only when named explicitly and never widens its boundary. Documents fetched through a desktop session are tagged L4.

Curn.notes: Snapshot get_data parameters {'Curn': 'USD'} as in the reference get_tr(); every currency amount is requested in USD.

SDate.notes: Anchors every snapshot to the absolute as_of (ADR graft 4: never '0D'). The global SDate parameter is not shown in VENDOR_REFERENCE, so it is preflighted once a day per as_of on test_ric: 'probe' (a confirmed field) is requested with and without SDate and both values go to field_log (record in the admission log that values move with SDate). If the request with SDate fails, SDate is dropped (warned, logged); a historical as_of then has no anchor, so snapshots are NOT EVALUATED (NaN) instead of silently returning current values.

universe.notes: Official SCREEN universe (VENDOR_REFERENCE 2.2). Lists instruments active today: a historical as_of is survivorship-biased.

currency.notes: Last SCREEN argument; makes TR.CompanyMarketCap(Scale=6) USD millions.

country.notes: US listing (table 2.3 'US listing / share type'). Compiled from UniverseSpec.country.

security_type.notes: Only ORD (ordinary shares) is verified. Other canonical security types have no verified code and are screened locally.

listing_filters.label: exchange market not OTCM (OTC Markets excluded from the LSEG universe)
listing_filters.notes: From the official VolatilityScreening sample. Part of the LSEG universe definition (get_universe uses it too).

market_cap_usd_bn.notes: '>=' form used in official SCREENs. Catalog USD bn x 1000 = USD mn.

return_3m_pct.notes: In SCREEN, percent (used in official SCREENs). Not pushed: the vendor window is 3 calendar months while the catalog's return_3m_pct is 63 sessions, so a pushed threshold is not a superset of the local predicate and could drop names the local definition passes (a push-down can only narrow; dropped names are never re-checked). A meaning-changing mapping (ADR): evaluated locally from history.

return_1m_pct.notes: Code listed in table 2.3; only TR.TotalReturn3Mo is documented as percent inside SCREEN.

return_12m_pct.notes: Code listed in table 2.3; units not documented.

return_6m_pct.notes: TR.TotalReturn6Mo unverifiable (table 2.3). Computed locally from history.

price.notes: EOD close (table 2.3 'Last price'). Not shown inside an official SCREEN, so it is pushed only after a passing preflight that day. The latest close equals the latest adjusted close.

gics_sector.notes: TR.GICSIndustry / SubIndustry / SectorCode unverifiable. Pushed only as single-value IN / NOT_IN after a passing preflight, and only for labels in 'labels' (the 11 GICS sector names; SCREEN matching is exact, the local engine is case-insensitive). Confirm the returned spelling with verify_fields.

high_52w.notes: Code confirmed; use in SCREEN UNVERIFIED and the vendor value may not be corporate-action adjusted like the catalog's adjusted 252-session high. Computed locally.

drawdown_from_52w_high_pct.notes: Codes confirmed. Sign/scale and use in SCREEN UNVERIFIED. Compute px/hi52-1 locally. After admission (G5) an override may set units_verified=true (and a negative threshold_scale if the vendor reports the drop as a positive number).

volatility_20d_pct.notes: Realized TR.Volatility10D/20D/30D/60D/90D confirmed (TR.Volatility10D appears in official SCREENs); units and the estimator (vs annualised stdev of daily log returns) are undocumented. Computed locally.

enterprise_value_usd_bn.notes: TR.EV confirmed. The vendor EV definition may differ from the catalog's market cap + total debt - cash, so it is not pushed (a meaning-changing mapping).

ev_to_ebitda.notes: TR.FwdEVToEBITDA unverifiable. Vendor EV / EBITDA definitions differ from the catalog's: not pushed.

ev_to_sales.notes: Vendor EV definition differs from the catalog's: not pushed.

net_debt_to_ebitda.notes: Net debt definitions differ (TR.NetDebt vs TR.F.NetDebt): not pushed.

operating_margin_pct.notes: TR.OperProfitMarginPct / TR.OperatingMargin unverifiable; official samples show only TR.OperatingProfitMarginPct5YrAvg and TR.PretaxMarginPercent.

sma_50.notes: Compute from TRDPRC_1 history; MAVG inside SCREEN UNVERIFIED.

sma_200.notes: Compute from TRDPRC_1 history; MAVG inside SCREEN UNVERIFIED.

sma_50_vs_sma_200_pct.notes: SMA50 > SMA200 is local for LSEG (VENDOR_REFERENCE section 4).

rsi_14.notes: Compute Wilder locally. TR.RSISimple14D appears only in a sample comment (simple, not Wilder); RSI() smoothing undocumented.

macd_signal.notes: No field exists: EMA9 of the MACD line locally.

rel_volume_5d.notes: Volume ratio computed from ACVOL_UNS history (VENDOR_REFERENCE section 4: local).

avg_dollar_volume_20d_usd_mn.notes: Compute ACVOL_UNS.tail(20) x close; TR.AvgDailyVolume6M is third-party and 6-month only.

rel_strength_3m_pp.notes: Local ratio vs .SPX (benchmark undocumented; .SPX history may be unentitled, fall back to SPY). TR.RelPricePctChgYTD is YTD only.

revenue_growth_last_q_yoy_pct.notes: TR.RevenueActValue(Period=FQ0) vs (Period=FQ-4), computed locally. FQ-4 combination UNVERIFIED. Single-quarter, not LTM.

revenue_growth_yoy_pct.notes: No verified LTM revenue field. LSEG supplies the single-quarter YoY (revenue_growth_last_q_yoy_pct) instead; trailing growth is residual.

short_interest_pct_float.notes: 100*TR.ShortInterest(SDate)/TR.SharesFreeFloat(SDate) computed locally. Third-party evidence only. TR.SIShortInterest unverifiable.

days_to_cover.notes: TR.ShortInterest / avg20(ACVOL_UNS); TR.ShortInterestDTC was found nowhere.

iv_30d_pct.notes: RIC <root>ATMIV.U + TR.30DAYATTHEMONEYIMPLIEDVOLATILITYINDEXFOR{CALL,PUT}OPTIONS; pattern verified for WMT only. Fetch for survivors only.

put_call_volume_ratio.notes: No field: compute from the chain (PUTCALLIND, ACVOL_1, OPINT_1). US chain RIC 0#<root>*.U and ACVOL_1/OPINT_1 unverified; not implemented.

name.notes: From the reference CORE map (VENDOR_REFERENCE 2.2 sample); not a row of table 2.3.

gics_industry.notes: TR.GICSIndustry/SubIndustry/SectorCode unverifiable (TR.GICSIndustryCode is corrected but is a code, not a name). Preflighted.

exchange.notes: ISO 10383 MIC; mapped to the canonical exchange label (unknown MICs pass through unchanged).

country.notes: ISO alpha-2 of the listing exchange (the canonical 'country' is the primary-listing country).

security_type.notes: Only ORD is verified; other codes pass through unchanged (they never match 'common_stock').

revenue_last_q.unit: USD (Curn=USD; no Scale parameter: absolute units ASSUMED, record in the admission log)
revenue_last_q.notes: Revenue growth YoY row: FQ0 vs FQ-4 computed locally; single quarter, not LTM.

fcf_ttm.notes: TR.FreeCashFlow(Period=LTM); TR.F.LeveredFOCF: third-party live-validated only. Preflighted.

shares_outstanding.notes: Free float / shares row; TR.CompanySharesOutstanding is third-party.

report_date.notes: Earnings events row lists the bare TR.RevenueActReportDate (corrected), whose default period is not documented (I/B/E/S actuals may default to the fiscal year, FY0) and so may not be the report date of the FQ0 values in this section. The period is pinned to FQ0 to match revenue_last_q; that parameterised form is not in VENDOR_REFERENCE, so it is unverifiable and preflighted. A report date after as_of blanks the row (look-ahead guard); while this leg is NOT EVALUATED the guard is inactive and the adapter warns.

revenue_ntm_est.notes: Period=NTM is third-party. The corrected form TR.RevenueMeanEstimate(Period=FY1,Scale=6,Curn=USD) is FY1, not NTM, and is NOT substituted (meaning-changing).

last_eps_surprise.notes: Earnings events row. Units undocumented: not served until admitted (set units_verified=true in an override).

last_earnings_date.notes: Report date of the latest quarterly (FQ0) revenue actual. The bare corrected form has an undocumented default period (possibly FY0, i.e. months stale), so the period is pinned; the pinned form is not in VENDOR_REFERENCE: unverifiable, preflighted.

short_interest_shares.notes: Reference form TR.ShortInterest(SDate=0D), anchored to the absolute as_of. Third-party evidence only. LSEG keeps short interest only for listed names (survivorship). Scale UNVERIFIED: VENDOR_REFERENCE table 2.3 says '100*TR.ShortInterest(SDate=0D)/TR.SharesFreeFloat(SDate=0D) ... The exported expression returns a fraction', i.e. a factor-of-100 mismatch between this field and float_shares, and it is not known which one is off. Not served until verify_fields on IBM.N plus a second source fixes the scale; then admit it with units_verified=true (and the right to_canonical) in an override.

short_interest_shares_1m_ago.notes: As short_interest_shares, 30 calendar days earlier (same scale caveat).

float_shares.notes: TR.SharesFreeFloat is third-party (TR.FreeFloat / TR.FreeFloatPct are corrected but their units are undocumented). Scale UNVERIFIED: see short_interest_shares (the reference's '100*SI/float ... returns a fraction' remark implies a 100x mismatch between the two legs). Not served until admitted.

settlement_date.notes: Not in VENDOR_REFERENCE: the '.date' field property is standard TR syntax but unverified for this field. Preflighted.

iv_30d_atm.notes: Pattern verified for WMT only, so each <root>ATMIV.U must resolve (unresolved -> NaN). Fetch for survivors only. IMP_VOLT is an alternative.

adjustments.notes: get_history(..., adjustments) is corrected, but these values and the corporate-action adjustment of TRDPRC_1 are UNVERIFIED: cross-check drawdown vs TR.Price52WeekHigh around splits (LSEGProvider.crosscheck_adjustment). Preflighted once a day on test_ric (the close history is requested with and without them); if the request with them fails they are dropped (library default adjustments), warned and logged.

open.notes: Not in VENDOR_REFERENCE (standard historical-pricing name). Preflighted; NaN when it fails.

high.notes: Not in VENDOR_REFERENCE (standard historical-pricing name). Preflighted; NaN when it fails.

low.notes: Not in VENDOR_REFERENCE (standard historical-pricing name). Preflighted; NaN when it fails.

benchmark.notes: Relative strength row: local ratio vs .SPX; benchmark undocumented; .SPX history may be unentitled (fall back to SPY). The SPY RIC is not in VENDOR_REFERENCE.

news.notes: ld.news.get_headlines / get_story confirmed; content is licence class L3 (Reuters copyright) through a platform session and L4 through a desktop (Workspace) session. The 'R:<RIC>' query syntax follows the LSEG-API-Samples news examples (not reproduced in VENDOR_REFERENCE).

filings.notes: filings.search.Definition(feed=Feed.EDGAR, ...) / filings.retrieval.Definition(...) confirmed (Filings entitlement needed). Search parameters beyond feed are NOT in VENDOR_REFERENCE, so this is off by default: set enabled=true and search_parameters (placeholders {ric} {ticker} {start} {end} {limit}) in an AITRADING_FIELDMAP_LSEG override after verifying them. SEC EDGAR (L0, aitrading.data.sec_edgar) is the preferred filings source.

transcripts.notes: StreetEvents XML over SFTP ftp-setranscripts.lseg.com:/TRANSCRIPT/XML_Add_IDs/Current (separate licence, L3; pin the host key). Out of scope for this adapter: get_documents returns no transcripts.
